title: Playing around Franklin and Iberville and the dog house
summary: He played in the French Quarter district, the dog house and other spots around Franklin and Iberville, until about seven or eight years earlier.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Ask me if he's ever owned Franklin and Custom House.
So was you ever owned Franklin and Custom House? Ever had a run? Was you ever owned Franklin and Custom House? No. He never played. He was owned the old age of 69, you know. Hmm?
He said, did you ever hang around, what is it? Play around Franklin and Iberville. Did you ever play music around Franklin and Iberville? Franklin and Iberville?

Iberville. Oh yeah, yeah. John 25, there was a place around there, Pete Lally, Howard Parker, Billy, you know, all of them, but the district was open. And then that's the district closed where everything was like, but I used to play around in the French Quarter, you know, that part in the doghouse. You know what I'm talking about? I didn't know if they were up yet.
The doghouse is gone, but I remember it. Yeah.

And then I went to the baby with the doghouse. He was back on Franklin and Iberville. I remember there. I remember there. And then I used to play for the last roundup. I used to play for the Calidator. Chatton, Chatton the Fitter. All them places most down that way, you know. That's been about seven, eight years ago.
